subtitle: Out Cebu · China Eastern Airlines
overview: Fly Cebu to Beijing via Shanghai on China Eastern, tour Tiananmen Square, the Forbidden City, the Great Wall, Temple of Heaven and Qianmen Old Street, then take a 2nd-class bullet train to Shanghai for the Bund and Nanjing Road. Stay in a local 5-star resort in Beijing and a 4-star hotel in Shanghai. Shop visits are part of this tour.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Nov 25–Dec 1 2026 to Dec 4–10 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Water Cube: The Beijing National Aquatics Centre from the 2008 Olympics, seen from outside.
placeDesc.Bird’s Nest: Beijing's National Stadium with its steel lattice design, built for the 2008 Olympics and seen from outside.
placeDesc.Wangfujing Pedestrian Street: A famous Beijing shopping and snack street, visited on the evening of arrival.
placeDesc.Tiananmen Square: One of the largest public squares in the world, in the heart of Beijing.
placeDesc.Forbidden City: The former imperial palace of Ming and Qing emperors in Beijing; entrance ticket included.
placeDesc.Juyongguan Great Wall: A well-known section of the Great Wall north of Beijing, set in a mountain pass.
placeDesc.Temple of Heaven: A Ming-era temple complex in Beijing where emperors held ceremonies for good harvests.
placeDesc.Qianmen Old Street: A restored traditional shopping street south of Tiananmen Square.
placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverfront promenade with historic buildings facing the Pudong skyline.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: A TV tower in Pudong with its distinctive spheres, seen from outside on this tour.
placeDesc.Chenghuangmiao Temple: The City God Temple area in old Shanghai, with traditional buildings and shops.
placeDesc.Nanjing Road: Shanghai's main pedestrian shopping street, lined with stores and neon lights.
placeDesc.Starbucks Flagship Store Shanghai: A large Starbucks Reserve store in Shanghai, visited on the last day.
